currentSourceInspection.observation: Configure validates bounded conditional revision/operation id; changes config/revision/one last operation under one write lock, retains runtime counters, restores full prior state on storage failure; no new awaited call while this guard is held.
Preset configure sends only mode, expectedConfigRevision, operationId and rereads effective state; no consent mutation in this path.
Restricted agent write allowlist excludes proactive config; scope cannot be enlarged by the new revision metadata.

485: /// Restricted AI/tool-plane boundary. Human-only route families stay denied
486: /// until explicitly reviewed. Safety-decreasing operations (stop, revoke,
487: /// cancel) and canonical tool calls remain available.
488: fn agent_request_allowed(method: &axum::http::Method, path: &str) -> bool {
489:     use axum::http::Method;
490:     if method == Method::GET {
491:         return !path.starts_with("/v1/memory")
492:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/assets")
493:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/knowledge")
494:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/agent-sessions")
495:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/activity")
496:             && path != "/v1/audit"
497:             && path != "/v1/outbox"
498:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/ui/preferences")
499:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/onboarding")
500:             // 配對指紋/裝置清單屬人類層：agent token 不可讀。
501:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/mobile")
502:             // 角色 instance／adapter 登記與 Character Session 屬可信 host 層：
503:             // agent token 不可讀（`/v1/character-session*` 也在這個前綴內）。
504:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/character")
505:             // 「未解決停止」＝哪些感測可能還在擷取、但沒有人確認停了。解除
506:             // （`POST .../dismiss`）本來就只有人類做得到；讀取面也必須同一層，
507:             // 否則 AI 讀得到一份使用者還沒處理的隱私待辦，只差不能按下按鈕。
508:             // 只排除這一支：`/v1/sensors`（狀態）與 `/v1/sensors/stop`（安全
509:             // 遞減）不受影響。
510:             && !path.starts_with("/v1/sensors/unresolved");
511:     }
512:     if matches!(
513:         path,
514:         "/v1/emergency-stop"
515:             | "/v1/stop-all"
516:             | "/v1/session/revoke"
517:             | "/v1/session/stop"
518:             // 停止所有感測也是安全遞減操作（audit 記的是實際 principal）。
519:             | "/v1/sensors/stop"
520:     ) {
521:         return true;
522:     }
523:     if path.starts_with("/v1/actions/") && path.ends_with("/cancel") {
524:         return true;
525:     }
526:     // safety-invariants-078：`/v1/agent-sessions/{id}/interrupt` 指名單一 session，
527:     // 不像 estop／stop-all／sensors/stop 那樣是全域安全遞減操作——它有「誰的
528:     // session」這個語意，必須能證明擁有權。`AuthPrincipal::LegacyAgent` 是零欄位
529:     // variant，架構上不帶任何 session 身分（也建不了、列不到 session），所以在
530:     // 這個「純路徑比對」的位置根本沒有資料可比。因此不再放行：中斷 session 必須
531:     // 用 session-scoped capability token（`INTERACT_AI_SESSION_TOKEN`，見
532:     // `session_request_allowed`，只准中斷自己）或 human token。
533:     if path.starts_with("/v1/tools/") && path.ends_with("/call") {
534:         return true;
535:     }
536:     path == "/v1/observations/query"
537:         || path == "/v1/plans"

currentSourceInspection.observation: Last-instant stop/consent gate precedes timeout-bounded actuator dispatch.
Recipe evaluation still stops on estop/proactive pause/no session; full evaluation body byte-identical to baseline.
Bounded cancellable jitter, stop/pause recheck and execute_plan(Autonomous) preserved; recipe engine algorithms unchanged.

conclusion: No additional concrete reachable finding identified in the changed proactive configuration boundary and its unchanged recipe/executor dispatch boundary. This is a scoped read-only review, not an exhaustive old-code correctness or performance audit.
